information: The registration fee would be charged per event. The maximum payment for early bird is IDR 100.000 and maximum IDR 150.000 for on the spot payment. For further information you can contact the contact person or check it at [the website](http://pekalonganrubikscompetition2016.weebly.com/registration.html).
